title: Northreach security onboarding & evidence log
content:
Purpose:
This working log collects the security questionnaire responses, workshop notes, and an evidence index for the Northreach POC (private deployment evaluation). Primary goal is to capture what we provided, outstanding items, and owner actions for audit readiness and to support the sales/engineering review prior to Dedicated/Private contract negotiations.

Summary (tl;dr):
- Initial security workshop held 2025-06-18 with Northreach InfoSec and Platform teams.
- We completed 82% of questionnaire fields; outstanding items mostly around HSM/KMS proof, network egress controls, and encryption key rotation policy artifacts.
- Temporary mitigation implemented: ephemeral demo keys in customer VPC + access logs forwarded to their S3 bucket for the POC window.
- Next checkpoint: 2025-07-22 evidence handoff and SOC2 scoping call.

Workshop notes (2025-06-18):
Attendees: Aisha (SE), Liam (Solutions), Sofia (Security PM), Daniel (Infra), Northreach: Priya R. (Lead InfoSec), Omar H. (Platform), Elena (SRE)
Agenda: intro -> architecture walk -> questionnaire review -> evidence walk-through -> next steps
Key points:
- Architecture: private control plane, customer VPC peering, optional on-prem collector for logs. Northreach requires VPC-only ingress and no egress to public internet from inference nodes.
- IAM: they insist on least-privilege IAM for cross-account S3 writes and want a pre-signed role rotation cadence documented.
- Crypto: primary ask is support for customer-managed CMKs with HSM-backed keys (AWS CloudHSM / external HSM gateway). They asked for KMS key policy examples and evidence of PCI/HSM integration tests.
- Logging: they want 90-day retention and immutable storage (S3 Object Lock suggestion). We proposed retention in their S3 bucket, lifecycle tags, and an archive to Glacier Deep Archive for long term.
- Pen testing: they will require a third-party pentest report prior to production. POC can be sandboxed under NDA but production gating remains.

Questionnaire status (high level):
- Identity & Access Management: COMPLETE. We provided IAM role diagrams, sample least-privilege policies, and a list of service accounts used in the POC.
- Data encryption (at rest): PARTIAL. Provided docs on model artifact encryption and disk encryption; still gathering CMK key policy and HSM integration test logs.
- Data in transit: COMPLETE. TLS 1.2+ enforced between control plane and inference nodes; mTLS optional for private deployments.
- Key management: PENDING. Need to deliver evidence for CloudHSM connectivity test (NR-HSM-TEST-20250701) and key rotation logs.
- Network controls: PARTIAL. Provided VPC peering architecture and security group listing; need an egress-filtering rule snapshot showing deny-all-by-default configuration from inference subnets.
- Audit & Monitoring: PARTIAL. Supplied examples of CloudTrail and Fluentd/Syslog forwarding config; need proof of log delivery (S3 object manifest) for 2025-06-25 -> 2025-07-10 window.

Evidence inventory (index of artifacts produced / pending):
- NR-EVID-001: Architecture diagram (redwood/private-vpc-arch-v1.pdf) -> AVAILABLE (confluence link attached).
- NR-EVID-002: IAM least-privilege role CSV (nr-iam-roles-2025-06-20.csv) -> AVAILABLE.
- NR-EVID-003: TLS/mTLS policy export (nr-tls-policy-2025-06-22.txt) -> AVAILABLE.
- NR-EVID-004: Disk encryption AES-256 sample config (nr-disk-encrypt-sample.conf) -> AVAILABLE.
- NR-EVID-005: CloudHSM connectivity test logs (NR-HSM-TEST-20250701.log) -> PENDING (test scheduled, ETA 2025-07-10).
- NR-EVID-006: KMS key policy example (nr-cmk-policy-v2.json) -> PARTIAL (drafted; awaiting customer legal review).
- NR-EVID-007: Log delivery manifest for S3 bucket (nr-log-manifest-2025-06-25-0700.json) -> PENDING (ingestion delayed due to permission misconfig).
- NR-EVID-008: Access control audit (user/service account list with last-used) (nr-access-audit-2025-07-01.csv) -> AVAILABLE.
- NR-EVID-009: Pen test scope doc (nr-pen-test-scope-2025-07-10.pdf) -> DRAFT (to be signed by Northreach).

Sample responses (quotable snippets for questionnaire):
Q: "How are encryption keys stored and rotated?"
A: "For private deployments we support customer-managed CMKs. Keys can be stored in AWS KMS with CloudHSM-backed key material, or on customer HSMs via our external HSM gateway. Rotation is configurable; by default we recommend a 90-day rotation cadence for symmetric keys with automated rotation and documented rotation events captured in CloudTrail. (See NR-EVID-006 for sample keypolicy and NR-HSM-TEST-20250701 for connectivity proof.)"

Q: "Do you allow egress only to customer-controlled endpoints?"
A: "Yes. POC and private deployments can be configured with VPC-only egress. By default, inference nodes have deny-all egress and explicit allow rules to customer-managed S3 endpoints and artifact registries. We can provide a Terraform plan snippet showing security group rules and route tables on request."

Outstanding items & blockers:
- Action: run CloudHSM connectivity test in the customer lab (owner: Daniel Park) -> ETA 2025-07-10. Blocking delivery of NR-EVID-005.
- Action: provide S3 log manifest proof for 2025-06-25 -> 2025-07-10 (owner: Omar H.) -> ETA 2025-07-12. S3 write role needs permission fix (JIRA-1490).
- Action: finalize CMK policy with Northreach legal (owner: Sofia Martinez) -> ETA 2025-07-18.
- Action: draft signed pentest scope and schedule (owner: Aisha Banerjee) -> ETA 2025-07-22.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Customer requires FIPS-140 validated HSM for production. Mitigation: we have documented integration with CloudHSM and an option to use on-prem HSM gateway; capture evidence of FIPS certification from HSM vendor as a dependency and flag to legal/procurement.
- Risk: Egress restrictions cause monitoring blind spots. Mitigation: provide cross-account CloudWatch/CWL delivery and S3 object replication for immutable copies under customer control.

Action log (short):
- 2025-06-19: Uploaded initial questionnaire draft (NR-Q-2025-06-19) -> Aisha
- 2025-06-25: Ingest pipeline configured for log forwarding (test mode) -> Omar
- 2025-07-01: Access audit exported -> Liam
- 2025-07-10: CloudHSM test scheduled -> Daniel

Notes to self (working):
- Keep evidence IDs stable; append date stamp to avoid collisions.
- For legal: ask Northreach for specific HSM vendor model numbers and procurement timelines.
- Ensure we version all sample policies in confluence and link them in the final evidence zip.

Next steps / meetings:
- 2025-07-15: Internal security review (Redwood) to validate evidence packaging (owners: Sofia, Aisha).
- 2025-07-22: Handoff call with Northreach InfoSec (deliver: NR-EVID-005, NR-EVID-007 if available, pen test scope).

Appendix (quick links & artifacts):
- Confluence: Northreach onboarding page (see linked_artifacts).
- Terraform: VPC & SG snippets in repo (github.com/redwood-inference/infra-snippets/NR-vpc-2025).
- Slack threads: #nr-poc-security (search for thread "HSM test results").

TODOs (short):

- [ ] Prepare evidence ZIP with stable filenames and checksum manifest.
